Jade_Caitlyn.name: Caitlyn
Jade_Caitlyn.title: The Sheriff of Piltover
Jade_Caitlyn.lore: - Yordle Snap Trap (W) and 90 Caliber Net (E) do not trigger Headshot (P).
Jade_Caitlyn.blurb: - Yordle Snap Trap (W) and 90 Caliber Net (E) do not trigger Headshot (P).

spells.name: Piltover Peacemaker
spells.description: Caitlyn unleashes a penetrating shot that damages all enemies in a line.
spells.tooltip: Caitlyn fires a piercing shot that deals <physicalDamage>{{ initialdamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>, reduced by {{ extrahitpercentreduction*100 }}% for each subsequent enemy to a minimum of <physicalDamage>{{ minimumdamagecalc }}</physicalDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Yordle Snap Trap
spells.description: Caitlyn sets a trap to find sneaky yordles. When sprung by a champion, the trap immobilizes, reveals, and damages them over a short duration.
spells.tooltip:
Caitlyn sets a trap for {{ duration }} minutes that springs on enemy Champions, Rooting them and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over {{ rootduration }} seconds, revealing them for {{ visibilityduration }} seconds.

Only {{ maxtraps }} traps may be active at once.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: 90 Caliber Net
spells.description: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.
spells.tooltip: Caitlyn flies backward as she fires a net that deals <magicDamage>{{ netdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slows</status> the first enemy hit by {{ slowamount*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second(s).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ace in the Hole
spells.description: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to an enemy champion at a huge range. Other enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.
spells.tooltip: Caitlyn takes a second to line up the perfect shot at an enemy Champion, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ rtotaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> at {{ castrange }} range. Other enemy Champions can intercept the bullet.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Headshot
passive.description: Every few basic attacks, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing extra damage.
